rules.semantic: The sim RNG is a glibc-constant LCG; asking for a draw with bound 0 answers 0 and does NOT advance the stream (so a guarded draw costs nothing); a test override, when installed, answers instead of the world stream.

tests.note: normal arm: next(100) == lcg_draw, state_ == lcg_step; bound-0 arm: next(0) == 0 AND state_ unchanged, lines 301-303
override arm: positions use the spy answer 5, end_state == kPin so the stream never advanced

rules.semantic: Every per-floor lookup with a floor index outside 1..extra floors (including negative or too-large indices from a hostile snapshot/save) falls back to floor 0's grid, decor and smoother, so an untrusted floor can never index out of bounds.

tests.note: in-range arm: floor 1 grid holds PIX_ZSTAIR_DOWN where floor 0 holds PIX_ZSTAIR_UP: a distinct buffer
in-range decor_for_floor(1) invalid while floors 0 and 2 valid

rules.condition: !dec.valid() ; grid_x/y out of bounds ; d < DECOR_MAX && kDecorRegistry[d].conceals
rules.semantic: A walker is concealed by decor only on a cell whose decor id is registered as concealing (shrub); a level without a decor plane, an off-map cell or a non-concealing decor (bones, boulder) never conceals.

arms.when: decor id >= DECOR_MAX (hostile or future-version decor plane)
arms.observable: false, and no out-of-bounds read of kDecorRegistry

tests.note: no plane false; OOB -1 and 500 false; shrub true; boulder and empty false

other.note: smoothers_in_sync: invariant oracle (every floor's smoother targets its own grid and the world's RNG); no game rule, read by tests (test_level_editor_issue12_wall_crash.cpp asserts true after create/resize/load). The false arms are not directly asserted.

rebind_smoothers: re-targets each floor's smoother at its grid (or resets it when the grid is gone) and the world RNG after a world handoff (level_runtime_data.cpp:310,625); oracle smoothers_in_sync, asserted in TEST(Issue12EditorWallCrash, floor_smoothers_follow_the_live_world_rng_across_a_level_load).
